digest.component_or_area: ticket store and completion verification infrastructure
propositions: Full ticket-store materialization requires 135-235 seconds and performs work proportional to the inode tree; a pinned read-only Git-based view using commit OID can reduce scoped single-ticket extraction to ~29ms while allowing concurrent live mutations.
Pinned reads at a captured commit OID remain byte-identical after later live mutations advance the tracker HEAD, enabling stable completion verification without a whole-store copy.

Completion validity depends on exact ticket state, direct-children membership, transitive descendants, relations, global resolver inputs like .bridge_state/bindings.json, and alias-link resolution context; isolated scoped reads without full resolver context are insufficient.

Current rebar writes COMPLETION_VERDICT before STATUS under separate locks and can leave a passing sidecar after a losing review; atomic bundling of VERDICT+STATUS+SIGNATURE in one local commit is required.

Parallel completion runs must validate relevant ticket/hierarchy/link deltas between a pinned baseline OID and live HEAD under the mutation lock, with compare-and-swap semantics for ref advancement to detect conflicts and retry.
